selection_policy: Five easy and five hard instances selected from static task metadata before any CritiqueCode trial.

easy.reason: One feature test, one-file patch, small requested behavior change.
One feature test and one-file patch focused on UUID conversion.
One feature test and one-file patch for issuer validation.
One feature test and a small two-file configuration change.
One feature test and a small three-file loading behavior change.

hard.reason: Multiple feature tests and a large BestOfN behavior change.
Ten feature tests and a multi-file public API/topology change.
Twenty-nine feature tests covering a cross-cutting response-id rename.
Multi-file storage/FSM/scene behavior with a broad regression surface.
Large code-and-documentation migration touching prompt templates, parsing, and agent APIs.

notes: FeatBench v1.0 does not provide an official difficulty column; easy/hard labels are static selection labels.
The final freeze occurs only after every selected instance passes oracle validation.
All selected repositories are library-style, CPU-only, Dockerfile-backed tasks with no planned external service dependency.
